objective: Make the previously-documented Türkiye price-sourcing workflow explicit in the pre-read nutrition procedure, while preserving all existing nutrition and live-source authority and no app writes.
trigger_classes: skills/nutrition.md procedure text changed (architecture-sensitive CI guard)

roles_before.description: Existing nutrition pre-read gates and selection of evidence owners and domain methodology
Whole-system health and safety audit, downstream impact check, and no unverified claims
Exact baseline decision, prior Ucuzradar/Market Fiyatı roles, user-reported price evidence
Requirement to check fresh prices and stock and distinguish external evidence from facts
Cronometer ownership, externalized cognition, no unapproved live app mutations
Existing domain routing, owner separation, adjacent health/finance composition

capability_probes.assertion: The unchanged skill still pre-reads domains/nutrition.md and current live Cronometer if needed; does not promote planned rows to actual intake.
A lower Ucuzradar posted listing cannot masquerade as physically available local stock; a similarly named but off-spec item cannot silently replace the chosen product.
The global domain router still separates health/nutrition/finance skills and live-source owners without new routes or unrelated modifications.
The new procedural sentence preserves owner-recorded user-provided prices and dates; prior source-role history is not removed; complete old nutrition skill remains in main/Git history.

tests.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; s=Path('skills/nutrition.md').read_text(); assert all(x in s for x in ('Ucuzradar','Market Fiyatı','kasap','fırın','do not ask again','TL/kg'))"
tests.expected: Process exits 0; new price-source actions and source provenance are explicit in nutrition procedure.

tests.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; s=Path('skills/nutrition.md').read_text(); assert all(x in s for x in ('Master Status Board','live Cronometer','food safety','Nutrient','product-specific nutrient claims','STALE-LIVE'))"
tests.expected: Process exits 0; original owner/evidence/safety/adherence semantics remain.

tests.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; s=Path('domains/nutrition.md').read_text(); assert 'Ucuzradar vs MarketFiyatı' in s and 'source-role' in s and '210 TL/kg' in s"
tests.expected: Process exits 0; prior owner source roles and user-provided historical price evidence remain readable.
